channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Air travel has been thrown into chaos with cancellations, diversions, and airspace closures after strikes on Iran
item.description: Following US and Israeli strikes, Iran and neighbor nations closed airspace, impacting airlines like Qatar Airways and Emirates.

item.title: Suspected airstrikes force evacuation at Dubai airport as drone debris kills 1 at second UAE hub
item.description: Videos online show debris and smoke as travelers rush to the exits. The Dubai airport said most of the terminals were evacuated ahead of the attack.

item.title: Claude hits No. 1 on App Store as ChatGPT users defect in show of support for Anthropic's Pentagon stance
item.description: OpenAI secured a Pentagon deal, sparking backlash and shifting some users' loyalties to Anthropic's rival Claude chatbot.

item.title: Satellite photos capture devastation at Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei's residence after US and Israeli strikes
item.description: At least six buildings were heavily damaged by the strike, with several collapsed, an analysis of fresh and older satellite images shows.

item.title: OpenAI shares its contract language and 'red lines' in agreement with the Department of Defense
item.description: OpenAI said its contract with the Department of Defense prevents its technology from being used for mass domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons.

item.title: 5 big takeaways from Sam Altman's Saturday night AMA on OpenAI's Pentagon deal
item.description: Sam Altman answered questions from users on X on OpenAI's red lines and talked about why the company's deal with the Pentagon happened so fast.

item.title: What to do if you're an American in the Middle East right now
item.description: Americans are being told to shelter in place in Middle Eastern countries including Iran, Qatar, and the UAE after the US and Israel struck Iranian cities including the capital, Tehran.

item.title: Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei was killed during strikes on Iran
item.description: Ayatollah Khamenei led Iran for nearly four decades before he was killed in joint US-Israel strikes on Saturday.

item.title: I'm a senior software engineer laid off from Block. There are 3 things I'm keeping in mind as I reenter the job market.
item.description: A senior software engineer laid off from Block shares three things he's focusing on as he reenters a tougher job market.

item.title: Photos show damage to major cities and tourist hotspots across the Middle East, from Dubai to Tehran
item.description: Photos taken during and after the strikes showed damage to Fairmont's luxury hotel in Dubai.
